activities.name: Check In and Get Ready For Dinner
Dinner at Auro (Four Seasons)
activities.location: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Napa Valley, Silverado Trail North, Calistoga, CA, USA
activities.notes: Rogelio Garcia helms the kitchen of Auro, as well as oversees the talented team of chefs and adds his culinary touch to TRUSS Restaurant + Bar. Auro received a coveted Michelin star under the helm of Garcia and his team in the 2023 Michelin Guide California. Born in Mexico City and raised in Los Angeles and Napa, Garcia held positions in some of wine country’s most respected Michelin-starred restaurants, from Cyrus to The French Laundry. Following his time in wine country, Garcia set forth to San Francisco where he earned Michelin stars of his own in 2018 and 2019 at Spruce. Garcia is a James Beard Foundation finalist for Best Chef: California; an alumnus of Bravo’s “Top Chef” Season 15; and author of an upcoming cookbook, “Convivir: Modern Mexican Cuisine in California’s Wine Country.”

activities.name: Diamond Creek Tasting (Ladies)
activities.notes:
Driving Directions:
About one half of a mile up Diamond Mountain Road, there will be a fork in the road and a large silver mailbox with 1500 posted on the side. Veer to the right and cross a small stone bridge.
 
Proceed to the gate on your left with ornate vines and rock pillars that reads “1500 Offices.” To the left is a private residence. Pull up very close to the gate and it will open away from you. Follow the driveway up one quarter of a mile to the winery. Parking is available right in front of the building.
